_help.stackedAspect: Screen shape that switches layouts: when the free space is this many times taller than wide (or more), the seed tray goes BELOW the board; otherwise it goes BESIDE it. 1.15 = slightly taller than square.
_help.trayTileMax: Biggest a seed in the tray can get, in pixels.
_help.trayTileMin: Smallest a seed in the tray can get, in pixels (44 = comfortable finger size).
_help.sidePanelShare: In the side-by-side layout, how much of the width the tray panel takes (0.3 = 30%).
_help.boardMargin: Empty space around the board, in hex sizes.
_help.dragLift: When dragging with a finger, how far above your finger the piece floats (pixels), so your finger doesn't hide it.
_help.dragStartDistance: How far (pixels) you must move before a press becomes a drag instead of a tap.
